decision: Verify the merged native-reply default through real SillyTavern, managed LambdaDB and Sol before release preparation; fix demonstrated failures within this scope.
retryPolicy: Preserve all original inputs/defaults and the first failed attempt. At most two explicit regenerate retries for a pending plain-user input after transient retrieval failure, with 1s/2s backoff. Do not rerun completed answers.
grading: Assistant semantic inspection of all actual answers and final prompts against frozen source/rubrics; no paid judge, official benchmark score or independent human assessment.
stopping: Complete all 11 generations and lifecycle/source/delivery/safety checks, or retain a concrete blocker without rerunning completed answers; verify owned collection absence and remove saved/runtime credentials.

origin.adaptation: Reuse complete original 63-message histories; close the trailing inventory user note with its already-existing acknowledgement. The semantic-location history additionally receives the original two-message book prefix. No answers/rubrics are placed in model prompts. Existing native reply fixture questions provide ambiguity/topic change; the bank account absence probe is derived from the existing missing-serial control.
